notes.title: v0.2.0 Major Update
notes.content:
CHANGES

 New non-VR launch option: no longer VR only.
 Two new tangent universes: The new tangent universes serve as boss puzzles that replace previous levels of the game to create a more diverse and challenging experience.
 Tangent Universe I: "The cabin in Hana where you finalized the equation that would unlock the potential of a mysterious new substance with negative mass."
 Tangent Universe II: "The youth lecture on the neurobiological implications of human time travel at the Kavli Institute for Brain Science."
 Redesigned the main puzzle interactions to create a primarily cerebral experience and more relaxed way to engage with the game. This redesign also strengthens the alignment between the VR and non-VR launch options.
 New dodge mechanic.
 Overhauled family interactions:  your wife and daughter are now much more dangerous.
 Approximately 85% of music replaced.
 New sound effects added.
 Wife and daughter reskinned.
 Final bosses reskinned.
 Animation updates.
 Pricing Adjustment.


FIXES

 Removed and/or updated some threats.


ADJUSTMENTS

 More forgiving puzzle timer on higher levels.
 More forgiving door timer on lower levels.
 Various optimizations.
 Various cosmetic and technical adjustments.

notes.title: 51:22:51 Update 0.1.2 Released
notes.content:
CHANGES

 Began the process of updating and polishing all of the animations - this process will likely continue throughout the remainder of development as we work towards our goal of building the first Sci-Fi Horror Techno Ballet (please excuse the potential word salad, but this is sincerely our goal).
 Overhauled the NPC interaction system to make the different iterations of the main character's family appear more like apparitions.
 Overhauled the pause menu - added English to the menu to better clarify the game settings.
 Increased the speed of the doors when opening and closing.


FIXES

 Addressed some of the pop-in problems in smaller rooms - please contact us in the Steam Community hub if you experience performance issues.
 Addressed the duplicate audio cues when family members reach the stair portals.


ADJUSTMENTS

 Reduced haptics amplitude by 50% - a pause menu option to increase this setting back to the original 100%, and to generally alter this setting to suit your preference, is forthcoming.
 Tweaked the NPC navigation settings.
 Tweaked the AI for the primary threat, specifically addressing how the threat evades the player.
 Removed the option for 180 degree turn around.
 Various other small cosmetic and technical adjustments - please contact us in the Steam Community hub if you experience performance issues.
